title: Add retry to export
input:
Export retries a failed upload up to 3 times with 2s backoff.

Why: flaky network drops large exports.

Done when: a failed upload retries 3 times; the 4th failure shows the error.

title: Dark theme for dashboard
input: Add a dark theme to the dashboard. Do NOT touch the settings page or the sidebar, those come later.

title: Экспорт в CSV
input: Нужно добавить export tickets в CSV: колонки key, title, status. Кодировка UTF-8 with BOM, чтобы Excel открывал нормально.

title: Better search
input: search should be better and faster, users complain

title: Panel flickers
input: Panel flickers on resize. Repro: 1) open a ticket 2) drag the sidebar edge 3) watch the header. Expected: no flicker.
